title: Stream transcript (valid): SESSION_HEARTBEAT with empty payload
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with SESSION_INIT followed by a SESSION_HEARTBEAT entry carrying an empty (zero-length) payload. Validates that heartbeat keep-alive frames are accepted when correctly formed. Does not require live TCP/QUIC transport.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
SESSION_HEARTBEAT requires zero payload size per spec.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
